scope: hydrostatic form coefficients of the Wigley parabolic hull (geometry + static closure only; NOT seakeeping / wave-body motion)

reference.source: closed-form Wigley (1934) parabolic hull integrals — standard seakeeping texts (Faltinsen, Lewis); independently re-derived with sympy

caliber.method: voxel mask (wigley_hull_mask, bitwise-identical to the library) integrated in memory-safe blocks
caliber.note: pure geometry+statics closure; does not depend on the free-surface pressure field

convergence.note: low-L voxel staircasing is large (C_B +21% at L=160); only L>=640 enters 3% — a recorded boundary condition

verdict: PASS: every form coefficient <=3% at L=640/960, inter-grid span <=3%
